'''Bascome''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of [[Elite Squadron]], which was part of the [[Thyferran Home Defense Corps]], the military force comprised of [[Vratix/Legends|Thyferran]] personnel. The Defense Force was created by former [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] [[Ysanne Isard]] to help augment the forces she had brought to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]] after fleeing from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Bascome participated in the [[Battle of Halanit|destruction]] of the [[Halanit]] colony.<ref name="bacta" />
